description: Land Reform Commission - The Land Reform Law No. 1 of 1972 as amended by the Land Reform (Special Provisions) Act No. 39 of 1981 read with Paragraph (2) of Article 44 of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the revocation and re-vesting of land (Hantane Estate) between the National Housing Development Authority and the Land Reform Commission. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and administrative divisions, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a government minister is named, the core content is about land transfer rather than government personnel or structural changes.
